title: Software Developer
description: Builds and maintains websites, mobile apps, and software tools that help people and businesses solve everyday problems.
day_in_the_life: You write and test code, fix bugs, review teammates' work, and break user needs into small, working features.

education_routes.title: Self-Taught Portfolio + Free Certifications
education_routes.summary: Build 3 real web projects using freeCodeCamp and CS50, publish code on GitHub, and apply for junior roles or apprenticeships.

education_routes.summary: Polytechnic diploma, community college associate degree, or paid software apprenticeship combining practical labs with work.

title: Data Analyst
description: Turns messy tables and numbers into clear charts and answers that help teams make better decisions.
day_in_the_life: You clean spreadsheets or SQL databases, spot trends in sales or health records, and share simple dashboards with managers.

education_routes.title: Free Online Data Portfolio + Financial-Aid Certificate
education_routes.summary: Learn spreadsheets, SQL, and dashboards via Kaggle Learn and Coursera financial aid, then publish 3 public data analyses.

education_routes.title: Bachelor's in Statistics, Math, Commerce, or Computer Science
education_routes.summary: Any analytical undergraduate degree paired with SQL and spreadsheet projects opens entry analyst roles.

growth_outlook.label: Fast growing
growth_outlook.note: Organizations of every size rely on clear reporting and operational data.

months_6: Build 3 clear one-page reports using SQL + charts.

years_2: Add Python automation and business storytelling to move into senior analyst roles.

source: U.S. BLS OOH & National Career Service India

title: Cybersecurity Analyst

day_in_the_life: You monitor security alerts, check suspicious logins, help teams update software safely, and document incident fixes.

education_routes.summary: Start with Cisco Skills for All free labs and IT helpdesk work, then earn an entry credential like ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity.

education_routes.title: IT / Cybersecurity Diploma or Bachelor's Degree
education_routes.summary: Structured labs in networking, operating systems, and ethical defense.

growth_outlook.label: Fast growing

source: U.S. BLS OOH & Cisco Skills for All

title: IT Support Specialist
